assertions.name: Pengikatan build-to-source valid dan BUILD_ID tersinkronisasi
Autentikasi sesi staf pada aplikasi Next.js asli (/login -> /dashboard)
Tampilan pesan belum dilabeli: badge 'Belum Dilabeli', kategori rule asli, tombol konfirmasi & koreksi
Konfirmasi 1-klik tersimpan: status 'confirmed', aktor sesi server, rule asli di messages tetap utuh
assertions.expected: UI: Terkonfirmasi & Komplain Koneksi; DB: status=confirmed, actor=staffUserId, rule_preserved=true

assertions.name: Kegagalan konfirmasi langsung: error alert role='alert' aria-live='polite', tahan 2x polling, retry sukses, dismiss 'Tutup', switch bersih
assertions.expected: errorVisible=true, role=alert, 2x polling survive=true, retrySuccess=true, dismiss=true, switchIsolation=true

assertions.name: Penyimpanan berulang dengan nilai identik bersifat idempoten tanpa duplikasi history
Koreksi klasifikasi tersimpan: badge 'Dikoreksi', label 'Bukan Komplain', catatan tersimpan, riwayat terlacak
assertions.expected: UI: Dikoreksi & Bukan Komplain; DB history count=2 (confirmed -> corrected)
assertions.actual: UI badge=Dikoreksi, staffVal=Bukan Komplain, DB history count=2

assertions.name: Preservasi draft editor saat polling server & resiliensi loading in-flight tanpa pemutusan dini
Rekonsiliasi server: respons simpan lama ditolak, Versi B polling bertahan, editor & draft A utuh, kontrol Versi C diterapkan, korelasi terbukti
assertions.expected: staffACommitted=true, invalidBearer=true, versionBVisible=true, preReleaseDraft=true, immediateKept=true, postReleaseDraft=true, subsequentKept=true, dbConsistent=true, historyConsistent=true, negativeCorrelator=true, controlCApplied=true, conv2Clean=true
assertions.actual: immediateKept=true, postDraft=true, dbActive=true, history5Rows=true, negCorrelator=true, controlC=true, conv2Clean=true

assertions.name: Aksesibilitas keyboard fitur klasifikasi: Tab, Shift+Tab, Arrow keys, typing, Enter simpan/batal
assertions.expected: allKeyboardFlowsPass=true (reach, open, cancel, change category, type notes, tab/shift-tab, save)
assertions.actual: editFocus=true, open=true, cancelFocus=true, canceled=true, radioChange=false, notesType=undefined, tabShiftTab=false, saveClose=false

assertions.name: Persistensi setelah reload: status 'Dikoreksi', label 'Bukan Komplain' tetap utuh dari DB
Penanganan error & preservasi draft: banner error tampil, pilihan kategori & catatan draft tidak hilang
Responsivitas mobile (375px) & ukuran touch target: tanpa overflow, kontrol form dan error banner >= 40px terukur
assertions.expected: hasHorizontalOverflow=false, all controls (form & error banner) width and height >= 40px, no button overlap
assertions.actual: overflow=false, editBtn=undefinedxundefinedpx, cancelBtn=undefinedxundefinedpx, saveBtn=undefinedxundefinedpx, optionCard=undefinedxundefinedpx, retryBtn=undefinedxundefinedpx, dismissBtn=undefinedxundefinedpx, noOverlap=false

assertions.name: Murni anotasi evaluasi: 0 outbound intents dikirim, 0 klaim dispatch, 0 mutasi complaint/lifecycle (sebelum vs sesudah identik)
Pembersihan proses Chrome/Next.js, user staf, dan fixture database selesai tanpa residu
